They could take us apart before we.. |The response of a [[Lance Squadron]] pilot when [[Carth Onasi]] ordered the ''Moomo Williwaw'' to be disabled|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 31">[[Knights of the Old Republic 31|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 31]]</ref>}}
The '''[[Pelagia Province|Pelagia]] Duplex Command Assault Gunship''', nicknamed the '''"Orphanmaker"''' or a '''Tapani Murder Machine''', protected the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] in the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. It was a military vessel outfitted for use in the private fleets of the [[Lords of the Expanse]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Used_starships_KOTORCG.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Duplex Command Assault Gunship docked beside a [[578-R space transport]].]]

The ship was designed with two cockpits meant to divide port and starboard offensive operations between the co-captains. It was also given redundant piloting controls, effectively enabling each pilot to seize control of the vessel from one another. The ship featured numerous built-in weapon mounts and power supply conduits, making it easier to install new weapons systems and upgrade existing weapons than any other ship of its size.

==History==
Its designers created the class to bolster Tapani's defenses in the turbulent time surrounding [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] violent campaign against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] ended, [[House Pelagia]] began selling these well-equipped gunships to outside buyers, which significantly increased their family holdings with profits from the design. A number of these ships were sold off just prior to the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and bought by wealthy individuals and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. The ships performed so well, that the eccentric [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Karoll Cilarnus]] sought to create a private version with twice the armaments. The result of this project would become known as the [[Moomo Brothers]]'s personal transport, the ''[[Moomo Williwaw]]''.
